notes.text: I-Blitz Split iyi-app entsha, eyakhiwe kabusha kusukela ekuqaleni: ithatha indawo ye-Blitz Split 2.4.0 futhi isebenza ku-Android, i-iPhone, i-iPad, i-Mac nakuwebhu.
Hlukanisa isindleko ngokulinganayo, ngamanani, ngamaphesenti, ngokwezabelo noma into ngayinye, kukhokha umuntu oyedwa noma abaningana.
Skena irisidi futhi i-app ikufundele izinto zayo nesamba.
Yakha amaqembu ohambo, ekhaya noma emicimbi futhi umeme abantu ngelinki noma ngekhodi ye-QR.
Bona ukuthi ubani kufanele akhokhe bani eqenjini ngalinye nakuwo wonke, rekhoda izinkokhelo futhi wenze izikweletu zibe lula ukuze izinkokhelo ezimbalwa zixazulule konke.
Konke kusebenza ngaphandle kwe-inthanethi: lokho okwenzayo kulondolozwa kudivayisi yakho futhi kuyathunyelwa lapho usuxhunyiwe futhi.
I-akhawunti ayibophi: xhuma i-Google noma i-Apple, noma ugcine ikhodi yokubuyisela, ukuze uthole amaqembu akho futhi kwenye idivayisi.
Phawula ngesindleko, namathisela izithombe, landela okwenzekile ku-Umsebenzi futhi ubone ukuthi imali iyephi ku-Izibalo.
Isindleko ngasinye nenkokhelo ngayinye kunohlobo lwemali yako, futhi i-app itholakala ngesiNgisi, isiPutukezi, isiSpanishi nesiFulentshi.
